planner.node_purpose: Turn the frozen DELL question tree and answer-free branch methods into a bounded set of evidence and financial-fact requests without answering the case.
planner.input_scale: One research question, one as-of date, and at most 16 compact branch method records; no evidence corpus or prior model conversation.
planner.schema_burden: Up to 16 tasks, each with no more than 8 evidence requests and 24 typed financial-fact requests.
planner.materiality_quality_risk: An omitted required branch or vague request can starve every downstream specialist; the graph separately rejects unknown or missing required branches.
planner.comparable_run_evidence: No paid run exists for this new vertical; the full nine-branch deterministic fixture serializes to 81,082 characters, so a 120,000-character fail-before-transport ceiling leaves bounded headroom while the first real call remains a qualification attempt.

specialist.node_purpose: One Lead-delegated Dell research obligation, using the existing autonomous Specialist loop, local sources, S2 and explicitly enabled public web. Produce a useful Chinese source-grounded workpaper, not a final verified product.
specialist.input_scale: One bounded task and selected dependency workpapers; sources are read on demand, preferably focused windows before expansion. A2 two-topic work took 17 requests/900455 tokens and reached unaccepted drafts. Retain original sources, own reasoning and errors; 500000 host characters provides measured correction headroom, not a provider context window.
required_outputs: relevant S2 facts or explicit non-S2 number provenance
valid workpaper or actionable human handoff
specialist.schema_burden: Same five native tools, source_space adds local/web selection. Focus the workpaper on material claims rather than restating every source; exact quotations remain required. Generic ad-hoc calculations are not yet exposed; use existing S2 derived metrics or distinguish reported observations without inventing calculated facts.
specialist.materiality_quality_risk: Peers, forecasts, architecture stages, policy dates and supply constraints must not be relabeled Dell realized financial results. Source reading permits non-S2 statements with disclosure, not admission or temporal verification. Missing observations are not proved public-information gaps.
specialist.comparable_run_evidence: A2 produced source-rich but unaccepted Q5/Q6 drafts before HTTP402. Cost audit found repeated review/reasoning costly. Same archived review input: Pro/low gave valid next action at 15023 output tokens; Flash/high exhausted32000 with no action. This supports a Pro/low full-task qualification, not a claim of equal quality. Local full-scope and web MCP checks precede this run.

counter.node_purpose: Stress-test the complete first-pass workpaper set and optionally request one material, targeted branch rework.
counter.input_scale: At most 16 compact branch workpapers from one case and no prior provider conversation or hidden reasoning history.
required_outputs: zero or one targeted reroute request
counter.schema_burden: One counter decision with up to 12 challenges and a single optional reroute containing bounded Evidence and Finance requests.
counter.materiality_quality_risk: An indiscriminate reroute creates cost and latency without improving the case; graph topology permits only one branch and one rework round.
counter.comparable_run_evidence: Deterministic fixtures prove the one-reroute topology and host challenge binding; no paid counter-node qualification exists yet.

lead.node_purpose: Autonomously allocate the complete Dell Q1-Q9 research coverage, reuse accepted Q1, inspect actual worker workpapers and plan targeted follow-ups before a review handoff. Does not write or approve the final report.
lead.input_scale: One complete Dell question, nine compact method records and reviewed Q1 seed; up to twelve dynamic task results accumulate over own native history. Workpapers not whole source corpora cross this boundary.500000 characters supports larger full-case collection while preserving tool feedback.
required_outputs: reflection on actual workpapers and missing coverage
handoff for independent review or actionable attention
lead.schema_burden: Existing three native planning tools and ResearchTaskSpec, one obligation per current worker task. Parallelism is two, not nine fixed named agents. Avoid recreating already accepted issuer research.
lead.materiality_quality_risk: All nine obligations must be represented before ready_for_review; task completion alone is not semantic, final-report, UI or product acceptance. Do not hide incomplete source routes or spend calls solely to fill a round count.
lead.comparable_run_evidence: A2 Lead first action used12278 input/8412 output tokens for two tasks under Pro/default-high. Full scope can have eight new primary tasks plus focused follow-ups.24000 combined output tokens accommodates larger planning and reasoning. Pro/low has one real review next-action diagnostic, full Lead quality remains to be tested.
